name: Electricity Bill Disconnection Scam
advisory_source: CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2023-0041 & RBI Consumer Alert on Utility Scams
description: Fraudulent messages falsely claiming electricity or power supply will be cut off tonight due to non-updated previous month bill, directing victims to contact personal mobile numbers or download malicious APKs.
keywords: power supply will be cut off
typical_phrases: Aapka bijli bill update nahi hua, connection kat diya jayega.
2 ghante ke andar bill pay nahi kiya toh light kaat di jayegi.
Electricity power disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm contact officer.
Aapka electricity connection aaj raat tak cut ho jayega.

name: Digital Arrest / CBI Extortion
advisory_source: CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2024-0018 & MHA Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)
description: Coercive psychological extortion where cybercriminals impersonate Police, CBI, Cyber Crime Cell, or Supreme Court officials via phone or video calls, claiming the victim is under digital arrest and demanding immediate payments to avoid jail.
keywords: video call arrest warrant issued by cbi
video call arrest warrant issued by cyber cell
typical_phrases: video call arrest warrant issued by CBI / Cyber Cell
video call pe arrest warrant issued by CBI
Aapke naam pe digital arrest warrant hai.
Supreme Court ka warrant issue hua hai, turant payment karo.
Police case se bachna hai toh abhi fine pay karo.
You are under digital arrest by Cyber Crime Cell.

name: IRCTC Ticket Cancellation Refund Phishing
advisory_source: CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2023-0029 on Malicious IRCTC Phishing & Rogue APKs
description: Phishing scams exploiting train passengers awaiting ticket cancellation refunds by sending spoofed messages with fake links or malicious Android APKs to capture NetBanking credentials, debit cards, and OTPs.
keywords: update bank details for irctc refund
typical_phrases: Your IRCTC ticket cancellation refund of Rs 1,450 is pending. Verify bank details to receive refund.
IRCTC refund failed for PNR 2847192841. Download IRCTC RailConnect APK to credit refund immediately.
Dear passenger, claim your IRCTC refund by updating your account details.

name: Part-Time Telegram Job Scam
advisory_source: CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2023-0015 & RBI Warning on Part-Time Work from Home Scams
description: Advance-fee and task-based financial fraud offering lucrative daily commissions for liking YouTube videos or completing Telegram tasks, followed by demands for upfront registration fees, deposits, or investments before funds can be withdrawn.
typical_phrases: YouTube video like karo aur Telegram pe screenshot bhejo, daily earning hogi.
Telegram task complete karo aur daily 5000 kamao.
Pehle recharge karo tab task unlock hoga.
Part time job hai, pehle registration fee pay karo.

name: KYC Expiry & Account Suspension Fraud
advisory_source: RBI Consumer Advisory on Fraudulent KYC Update & Phishing Links
description: Phishing and credential harvesting scams impersonating leading banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) claiming account or debit card suspension within 2 hours due to expired KYC, coercing victims into entering credentials or sharing OTPs.
typical_phrases: Sir aapka KYC expire ho gaya hai, abhi update karo.
URGENT: SBI account blocked within 2 hours submit PAN.
OTP bata do verification ke liye.
Your bank account will be suspended today. Update KYC immediately.

name: Telecom SIM Deactivation Threat
advisory_source: Department of Telecommunications (DoT) & TRAI Advisory on Impersonation and SIM Disconnection
description: Deceptive notices purporting to be from TRAI or the Department of Telecommunications threatening that the user's mobile number or SIM card will be deactivated or disconnected within 2 hours unless immediate verification is performed.
keywords: trai will disconnect your mobile number
trai ke order se sim band
typical_phrases: TRAI will disconnect your mobile number within 2 hours.
DoT alert: Your mobile number will be disconnected within 2 hours.
TRAI verification notice: Mobile SIM will be deactivated today.
TRAI ke order se sim band kar diya jayega.

name: Lottery & Fake Reward Scam
advisory_source: RBI Consumer Advisory on Lottery Fraud and Fake Prize Schemes
description: Advance-fee fraud informing victims they have won a high-value lottery, lucky draw, or KBC prize, requiring them to transfer processing fees or taxes to claim winnings.
typical_phrases: Congratulations! You won Rs 25,00,000 in KBC lottery lucky draw.
Claim your lottery cash prize by calling the manager.
You are the lucky winner of iPhone 15 jackpot.

name: UPI Collect Request Trap
advisory_source: NPCI & RBI Advisory on UPI Collect Request Frauds and PIN Misuse
description: Financial deception tricking victims into approving incoming UPI collect payment requests under the guise of receiving cashback, lottery money, or refunds by entering their UPI PIN.
keywords: paise lene ke liye pin dale
scan qr code to receive money
typical_phrases: Approve UPI collect request to receive Rs 2,000 cashback immediately.
Enter UPI PIN to receive money into your bank account.
Accept payment request on PhonePe / Google Pay to claim refund.
